newsitem.title: SPAIN: Forecast-Spain CPI consensus sees 0,35% Sept rise.
newsitem.headline: Forecast-Spain CPI consensus sees 0,35% Sept rise.

text.p: The following is a simple average of CPI forecasts contributed by private economists:
Mth Change Range Pvs Yr-yr Range 96/95 Ave

Core (%) Sept +0.28% (0.20/0.40) 0.2 3.55 (3.4/3.7) 3.42 3.75 Sources: Argentaria, AFI, Beta Capital, Banco Santander, BCH, Caja Madrid, BBV, Intermoney, BoA, Merrill Lynch, ICAE, BSN, C. Lyonnais, Fedea, Wrightson Ass, Caja Cataluna.
NOTE - The National Statistics Institute will publish the official figure on Oct 11. Core inflation excludes energy and unprocessed food.
